steps.title: Welcome to Northbridge
steps.text: Welcome to Northbridge, where it's your first week: new badge, new desk, new faces everywhere. But this office hides small slip-ups that attackers love, like a password on a sticky note or a laptop left unlocked. Shield, your sidekick, is here to help you spot them. Your mission is to find every risk before someone else does, so let the hunt begin!

steps.title: What is First Week Hunt?
steps.text: First Week Hunt is a hidden-object game for 2 to 6 players on one screen. You're looking at an office full of spots to tap. Players take turns hunting for eight real security risks hidden among safe look-alikes. Most points when every risk is found, or the two-minute clock runs out, wins.

steps.title: Hunt the office
steps.text: Welcome to your first week! Eight security risks are hiding in this office, mixed in with safe look-alikes.

steps.title: Tap a risky spot
steps.text: On your turn, tap anything that looks risky. Find a real one, score points, and keep going.

steps.title: Watch out for decoys
steps.text: A safe spot passes the turn. Two wrong taps in a row and you get hacked, back to zero!

steps.title: One Shield hint each
steps.text: Stuck? Your one Shield hint lights up a hidden risk, for a small cost.

steps.title: Beat the clock
steps.text: You have two minutes together. Highest score wins. Happy hunting!
